component.name: jMonkeyEngine SDK
component.summary: A complete 3D game development suite written purely in Java

description.p: The jMonkeyEngine SDK is an IDE based on Apache NetBeans for developing 3D applications and games with jMonkeyEngine.

ul.li: Scene Editor: preview scenes, edit transforms, add Controls and AppStates
Terrain editor, texture editor and model importers
Project templates, including Gradle-based games and the jME3 test suite
